en: A hand‑colored historical postcard showing elegantly dressed men and women gathered around a fenced mineral spring inside a grand hall with tall windows and ornate architectural details. The scene is indoors, with large doors opening toward a leafy park outside. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as the salt spring in Bad Elster. The style of clothing and printing suggests an early 20th‑century European spa resort setting.
